provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS DAST cumulative master pump, iteration 2 (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: An empty X-Content-Type-Options field value does not enable nosniff, so the missing-header rule must fire (shared empty-value normalisation on a second rule).

groundTruth.rationale: X-Content-Type-Options is present but empty. Browsers only honour the nosniff token, so an empty value leaves MIME sniffing enabled.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live request.
DPK-DAST-073 (non-nosniff value) must stay silent for an empty value; this case pins that separation.
